role: Separately pinned official CTL runtime repair used only to execute the unchanged official ACES v2 CTL source graph.

upstreamFix.releaseContainment: The fix is included in official CTL release ctl-1.5.4. This tool deliberately retains the already sealed ctl-1.5.3 base and applies only the two executable C++ hunks from the official fix, excluding unrelated workflow, Docker, and test-material changes.

changedFiles.effect: Retains the instruction guard and reports the maximum and executed instruction counts when it trips.

semanticPatch.claimLimit: This patch changes CTL interpreter capacity and diagnostics only. It does not modify ACES source, CTL language semantics, color transforms, input values, or output encoding.

sourceConstruction.procedure: Copy the sealed ctl-1.5.3 package into tmp/extraterrestrial, apply the sealed semantic patch with strip level 1, and verify the complete resulting source tree before CMake configuration.

build.packages: Exactly the compiler, linker, CMake, OpenEXR, Imath, zlib, libc, libstdc++, and transitive executable/header closure sealed by the base provenance and decision runner before and after execution.

requiredPreflight.unpatchedNegativeControl: The sealed unpatched ctl-1.5.3 executable must reproduce the sealed no-output crash phenotype for the unchanged wrapper plus official ACES v2 sRGB-piecewise ODT. This old/new executable differential is not, by itself, a direct instruction-guard diagnosis.
requiredPreflight.patchedPositiveControl: The patched executable must complete the same five records with finite output, then match pinned OCIO 2.4.2 within the declared float tolerance and in every final Q8 code.

license.name: custom AMPAS CTL license
license.requirements: Retain copyright, conditions, disclaimer, and no-endorsement terms.
